Conclusion: the evidence does not support naming any specific difference. The two checkpoints appear indistinguishable on this measurement.

Why: the L2 difference is zero at every (layer,position) cell we measured, and the logit‑lens top tokens are the same trivial/common tokens everywhere (likely an RMSNorm / small‑noise artifact). Patchscope produced no meaningful continuations. Together this indicates there is no measurable residual‑stream activation difference to interpret.
